info.title: InferenceX Data API
info.description:
Read benchmark, provenance, dataset, CollectiveX, and diagnostic data from the same sources that power InferenceX.

Optional inferencex-cli/<version> or inferencex-skill/<version> User-Agent markers attribute public GET arrivals, including cache hits and retries. X-InferenceX-Traffic separates normal, ci and validation requests. Only route templates, package versions, transport, environment and traffic class are recorded; no query values or user identifiers. Packaged clients can omit attribution with INFERENCEX_TELEMETRY=0. These headers do not affect authentication, response data or caching.
info.x-description-zh:
从 InferenceX 使用的同一组数据源中，读取基准测试数据、溯源信息、数据集、CollectiveX 数据和诊断数据。

可选的 inferencex-cli/<version> 或 inferencex-skill/<version> User-Agent 标识用于归类公开 GET 请求，包括缓存命中及重试。X-InferenceX-Traffic 区分 normal、ci 和 validation 流量。仅记录接口路径模板、包版本、客户端类型（CLI 或 skill）、部署环境与流量类别，不记录查询参数值或用户标识。包内客户端可设置 INFERENCEX_TELEMETRY=0 关闭来源标记。这些请求头不影响身份验证、响应数据或缓存。

get.description: Static discovery endpoint for the views API: models (with DB keys, category and release date), sequences, precisions, hardware (with vendor, architecture, TDP and per-provider hourly cost), frameworks, speculative-decoding methods, percentiles, x-axis and scale modes, chart metrics (bilingual labels, unit, polarity), quick-filter domains, reliability ranges, and overview/calculator/fleet option sets — plus the defaults the dashboard itself uses. Values come from the same registries the dashboard renders its controls from, so this response is the authoritative input catalog for the other /api/v1/views endpoints. Inference charts for models with category deprecated append (Deprecated) to the source attribution, including PNG exports and unofficial-run overlays, without deprecated background watermarks. This is presentation only and does not change view data. No database access.
get.x-summary-zh: 获取 views API 的全部选项域
get.x-description-zh: views API 的静态发现端点：模型（含数据库键、分类与发布日期）、序列、精度、硬件（含厂商、架构、TDP 及各供应商每小时成本）、推理框架、投机解码方法、百分位、x 轴与坐标缩放模式、图表指标（中英文标签、单位、极性）、快捷筛选域、可靠性时间范围，以及 overview/calculator/fleet 的选项集，并附仪表盘实际使用的默认值。所有取值直接来自仪表盘控件渲染所用的注册表，因此该响应是其余 /api/v1/views 端点的权威输入目录。分类为 deprecated 的模型会在推理图表的来源署名后添加 (已弃用)，英文页面显示 (Deprecated)；PNG 导出和非官方 run overlay 中也保留该后缀，不再显示“已弃用”背景水印。此变更仅影响展示，不改变视图数据。不访问数据库。

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response encoding. This discovery endpoint is JSON-only.
parameters.x-description-zh: 响应编码。该发现端点仅支持 JSON。

200.description: Every option domain the views endpoints accept, plus dashboard-parity defaults. Each model includes deprecatedSequences, combining global and model-specific sequence retirements. Qwen3.5 8K/1K is deprecated; Qwen3.5 AgentX and explicit historical selections remain available.
200.x-description-zh: 各 views 端点接受的全部选项域，以及与仪表盘一致的默认值。每个模型的 deprecatedSequences 包含全局弃用和该模型单独弃用的序列。Qwen3.5 的 8K/1K 已弃用；Qwen3.5 AgentX 保持启用，仍可显式选择历史结果。

400.description: The format value is invalid — this endpoint is JSON-only.
400.x-description-zh: format 参数无效——该端点仅支持 JSON。

get.summary: Get the main inference chart view
get.description: Returns the chart-ready series the /infx/inference scatter chart renders: per hardware config, x/y points at each measured concurrency for the selected metric, sequence, precisions and x-axis mode, with boundary and best-per-SKU flags computed by the same code the dashboard runs. Filters mirror the dashboard quick filters (gpus, vendors, framework families, deployment, spec). Use optimal=true for boundary points or best=true for the best series per GPU SKU. Measured-power boundaries follow the higher-power outer envelope: frontier.direction describes that boundary, while metric.direction remains the optimization direction used by best-per-SKU selection. All in Measured watts and energy support single_turn and AgentX rows with validated telemetry and supported topology; AgentX uses the power model’s agentic workload state without independent workload calibration. All in Measured adds tableRows with every GPU-valid observation in the selected scope and best-series selection (SKUs with no rankable estimate keep their rows), before optimal or axis clipping; unavailable estimates have y=null and a reason. series and count remain numeric chart points.
get.x-description-zh: 返回 /infx/inference 散点图所用的序列：按硬件配置分组，在所选指标、序列、精度与 x 轴模式下给出各并发档位的 x/y 数据点，并复用仪表板代码计算边界与 best-per-SKU 标记。筛选参数与仪表板快捷筛选一致（gpus、vendors、框架系列、部署模式、投机解码）。设置 optimal=true 可只保留边界点，best=true 可只保留每个 GPU SKU 的最优曲线。实测功耗使用较高功耗侧的外包络：frontier.direction 描述这一边界，metric.direction 则保留 best-per-SKU 选择所用的优化方向。整体实测功耗及能耗支持遥测已验证、拓扑受支持的 single_turn 和 AgentX 数据；AgentX 采用功耗模型的智能体工作负载状态，尚未针对该工作负载单独校准。整体实测指标另返回 tableRows，保留当前筛选范围和最优曲线选择内所有 GPU 遥测有效的观测点（没有可排名估算的 SKU 保留其全部观测点），不按 optimal 或坐标轴显示范围裁剪；估算不可用时 y 为 null，并给出原因。series 和 count 仍仅包含可绘制的数值点。

parameters.name: chipBasis
parameters.description: pool (default) or total. Chips that divide disaggregated input and output throughput and every metric derived from them: pool uses prefill chips for input and decode chips for output; total uses every chip in the deployment, the basis aggregated configs and tput_per_gpu always use. Aggregated rows are identical under both.
parameters.x-description-zh: pool（默认）或 total，指定分离式配置的输入、输出吞吐量及其派生指标所除的芯片数：pool 下输入按预填充芯片、输出按解码芯片计；total 按部署中的芯片总数计，与聚合配置及 tput_per_gpu 口径一致。聚合配置在两种口径下结果相同。

parameters.name: topologies
parameters.description: Comma-separated exact topology keys from the Dashboard topology selector or view point topologyKey. Filters allocation and parallelism without filtering concurrency; omitted means all. Preserve the keys verbatim. Unknown keys return no matching points.
parameters.x-description-zh: 逗号分隔的精确拓扑键，取自仪表板拓扑选择器或数据点的 topologyKey。按 GPU 分配和并行配置筛选，保留全部已测并发；省略时不限制拓扑。原样使用这些键，未知键不会匹配数据点。

parameters.name: allPoints
parameters.description: Boolean, default false. Include points clipped by dashboard limits; optimal and best still apply independently.
parameters.x-description-zh: 布尔值，默认为 false。包括被图表范围裁剪的数据点；optimal 和 best 仍独立生效。

parameters.name: best
parameters.description: Defaults to true: rank candidate frameworks per SKU within the selected precisions, using the current axes. Each candidate is scored by the area its measured Pareto frontier dominates (hypervolume from the origin, with lower-is-better axes taken as reciprocals so $/M tok ranks like tok/$); a curve earns nothing where it has no measurement. An unselected precision cannot displace a visible configuration. best=false returns all selected series, including vLLM and SGLang on the same SKU. Choosing a different model in the dashboard model selector resets manual legend choices to the destination model default; API requests are stateless, so pass best=false explicitly for each model when needed. The dashboard asks for a no-drama acknowledgement before showing both; the read-only API has no interactive consent state. This ranking is not a universal engine winner.
parameters.x-description-zh: 默认为 true：仅在选定精度内，按当前坐标轴对每个 SKU 的候选框架进行排名。每个候选按其实测 Pareto 前沿所覆盖的面积（hypervolume，以原点为参考点）计分；越低越好的坐标轴先取倒数，因此 $/M tok 与 tok/$ 的排名一致；没有实测数据的区间不得分。未选中的精度不会挤掉当前可见的配置。best=false 返回所有选定曲线，包括同一 SKU 上的 vLLM 和 SGLang。在仪表板的模型选择器中选择另一模型时，手动选择的图例曲线会重置为目标模型的默认选择；API 请求无状态，如需保留所有选定曲线，应在每个模型的请求中显式传入 best=false。仪表板在同时显示两者前要求确认不挑起争论；只读 API 不保存交互确认状态。此排名不代表某个引擎在所有情况下都更好。

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: As-of date (YYYY-MM-DD): the latest run on or before this date per config.
parameters.x-description-zh: 截止日期（YYYY-MM-DD）：每个配置取该日期当天或之前的最新运行。

parameters.name: dates
parameters.description: Up to twelve comma-separated YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD~rRUN_ID comparison entries. Date-only entries select that exact logical snapshot, not an as-of cutoff; run entries select the exact logical run snapshot. Each snapshot is evaluated independently.
parameters.x-description-zh: 最多十二个比较项，以逗号分隔，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD 或 YYYY-MM-DD~rRUN_ID。仅含日期时读取当天的逻辑快照，不按截止日期向前回溯；含运行 ID 时读取该次运行的逻辑快照。各快照独立计算。

parameters.name: deployment
parameters.description: Comma-separated deployment modes; agg expands to single-node and multi-node.
parameters.x-description-zh: 逗号分隔的部署模式；agg 会展开为 single-node 与 multi-node。

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Comparison range end, YYYY-MM-DD; must not precede start. Historical uses an inclusive data bound.
parameters.x-description-zh: 比较范围结束日期 YYYY-MM-DD，不得早于 start。历史视图将其用作含终点的数据范围。

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Response encoding. csv returns plotted points, or tableRows for All in Measured with unavailable y cells blank. serviceCompare, roleShare, powerFit, powerBreakdown and headroom analytical results require JSON and return 400 with CSV.
parameters.x-description-zh: 响应编码。csv 返回图表数据点；整体实测指标则导出 tableRows，不可用的 y 留空。serviceCompare、roleShare、powerFit、powerBreakdown 和 headroom 分析结果仅支持 JSON，与 CSV 同用时返回 400。

parameters.name: frameworks
parameters.description: Comma-separated framework families.
parameters.x-description-zh: 逗号分隔的推理框架系列。

parameters.name: gpus
parameters.description: Comma-separated hardware keys or bare GPU names to include (e.g. h200 or a full hwKey). When omitted, Qwen3.5 excludes MI300X, MI325X, H100, and H200. An explicit list overrides this default; gpus= includes all hardware.
parameters.x-description-zh: 逗号分隔的硬件键或 GPU 名称（如 h200 或完整 hwKey）。省略时，Qwen3.5 排除 MI300X、MI325X、H100 和 H200。显式列表覆盖此默认值；gpus= 包含所有硬件。

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Y-axis metric key or config key, e.g. tpPerGpu or y_tokensPerDollarN (see options → metrics).
parameters.x-description-zh: Y 轴指标键或配置键，如 tpPerGpu 或 y_tokensPerDollarN（见 options → metrics）。

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Frontend model display name (see /api/v1/views/options → models).
parameters.x-description-zh: 前端模型显示名（见 /api/v1/views/options → models）。

parameters.name: optimal
parameters.description: Return only boundary points per hardware, precision and snapshot date. Measured-power gauges use the higher-power outer envelope, matching the chart; other metrics use their Pareto frontier. The power envelope is not an efficiency recommendation.
parameters.x-description-zh: 仅返回每个硬件在各精度、各快照日期上的边界点。实测功耗指标与图表一致，保留较高功耗侧的外包络；其他指标保留各自的帕累托前沿。功耗包络不构成能效推荐。

parameters.name: percentile
parameters.description: Latency percentile for agentic-trace x fields.
parameters.x-description-zh: agentic-traces 场景下 x 轴延迟字段使用的百分位。

parameters.name: power
parameters.description: Comma-separated certified and/or legacy power tiers. Omit for all tiers.
parameters.x-description-zh: 以逗号分隔的 certified、legacy 功率数据等级。省略时选择全部等级。

parameters.name: precisions
parameters.description: Comma-separated precisions. When omitted, the densest available precision is auto-selected, matching the dashboard default.
parameters.x-description-zh: 逗号分隔的精度列表。省略时按数据最密的精度自动选择，与仪表盘默认行为一致。

parameters.name: priceSource
parameters.description: Profit: list, openrouter or custom. Inference/history: normalized or openrouter. Returned pricing records the prices actually used. Muse-Spark-Open defaults to list: Muse Spark 1.3 rates published at https://vercel.com/ai-gateway/models/muse-spark-1.3 ($1.25 input, $0.15 cached input and $4.25 output per million tokens). It prices Open checkpoint measurements, not Meta production costs or profits; the default 30% labCut is an editable assumption, not actual license terms.
parameters.x-description-zh: 利润视图支持 list、openrouter、custom；推理和历史视图支持 normalized、openrouter。响应 pricing 记录实际使用的价格。Muse-Spark-Open 默认使用 list，即 https://vercel.com/ai-gateway/models/muse-spark-1.3 公布的 Muse Spark 1.3 价格：每百万 token 输入 $1.25、缓存输入 $0.15、输出 $4.25。估算使用 Open checkpoint 的实测数据，并非 Meta 生产环境成本或利润；默认 30% labCut 为可修改的假设，并非实际许可条款。

parameters.name: runId
parameters.description: GitHub Actions run id. Returns exactly that run snapshot instead of the latest data.
parameters.x-description-zh: GitHub Actions 运行 id。返回该次运行的精确快照而非最新数据。

parameters.name: sequence
parameters.description: Benchmark sequence. Aliases like 8k-1k and agentic are accepted.
parameters.x-description-zh: 基准序列。也接受 8k-1k、agentic 等别名。

parameters.name: spec
parameters.description: Comma-separated speculative-decoding modes.
parameters.x-description-zh: 逗号分隔的投机解码模式。

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Comparison range start, YYYY-MM-DD. With end, adds the two endpoints, not every intermediate date. Historical uses an inclusive data bound.
parameters.x-description-zh: 比较范围起始日期 YYYY-MM-DD。与 end 一起只加入两个端点，不加入中间所有日期。历史视图将其用作含起点的数据范围。

parameters.name: tcoBasis
parameters.description: internal (default) or external. Applies the same configured owning/rental cost basis as the UI.
parameters.x-description-zh: internal（默认）或 external，使用与界面相同的自有或租赁成本口径。

parameters.name: unofficialrun
parameters.description: Up to eight comma-separated public CI run IDs. Surrounding whitespace and duplicates are removed; run indices follow the remaining order. Overlay sources remain separate from official data.
parameters.x-description-zh: 最多八个公开 CI 运行 ID，以逗号分隔。去除各项首尾空白和重复 ID 后，按剩余顺序分配运行索引。叠加结果与官方数据分开。

parameters.name: userCosts
parameters.description: JSON object from hardware keys to finite nonnegative USD/chip-hour values for user-priced metrics.
parameters.x-description-zh: JSON 对象，将硬件键映射为有限非负美元/芯片小时，用于自定义成本指标。

parameters.name: userPowers
parameters.description: JSON object from hardware keys to finite nonnegative power assumptions in kW/chip.
parameters.x-description-zh: JSON 对象，将硬件键映射为有限非负千瓦/芯片功率假设。

parameters.name: vendors
parameters.description: Comma-separated GPU vendors.
parameters.x-description-zh: 逗号分隔的 GPU 厂商。

parameters.name: xmetric
parameters.description: TTFT percentile used when the x axis shows time to first token.
parameters.x-description-zh: 当 x 轴为首 Token 时间（TTFT）时使用的百分位。

parameters.name: xmode
parameters.description: X-axis mode. Defaults to e2e for Qwen3.5 and interactivity for other models. An explicit value overrides the model default. e2e-normalized-interactivity uses persisted derived AgentX metrics, and unofficialrun overlays use the values reported by their run; points without eligible values are omitted.
parameters.x-description-zh: X 轴模式。Qwen3.5 默认为 e2e，其他模型默认为 interactivity；显式值覆盖模型默认值。e2e-normalized-interactivity 使用已持久化的 AgentX 派生指标，unofficialrun 叠加数据则使用该 run 自身报告的数值；没有合格数值的数据点不参与此视图。

parameters.name: xstat
parameters.description: Fixed-sequence service-axis statistic: median (default) or mean. Mean streaming speed is 1 / mean TPOT, not the arithmetic mean of per-request speeds. Mean TTFT and E2E use their recorded mean fields. Missing values are omitted, never replaced with median. Ignored for AgentX; params.xstat then resolves to null and xAxis.statistic records the effective percentile.
parameters.x-description-zh: 固定长度工作负载服务轴的统计量：median（默认）或 mean。Mean streaming speed 为 1 / mean TPOT，不是各请求速度的算术平均；mean TTFT 和 E2E 使用各自记录的均值。缺失时不回退到 median。AgentX 不使用此参数，params.xstat 为 null，xAxis.statistic 返回实际分位数。

parameters.name: serviceCompare
parameters.description: API-only analysis: include source options, equal-service percentage curves, an optional target comparison and the same-concurrency diagnostic table (matchedConcurrency). Uses scoped observed points before frontier/best pruning. No corresponding dashboard control or panel. JSON only.
parameters.x-description-zh: 仅通过 API 提供的分析：返回来源选项、同等服务条件下的百分比对比曲线、可选目标值对比，以及相同并发下的诊断表（matchedConcurrency）。使用筛选范围内、尚未经前沿和 best 筛选的实测点。仪表板不提供对应控件或面板。仅支持 JSON。

parameters.name: serviceBaseline
parameters.description: Exact baseline key from serviceSources. Omitted selects the first deterministic source; an unknown explicit key remains unavailable. Percent change is 100 × (comparator / baseline − 1).
parameters.x-description-zh: serviceSources 中的完整基准来源键。省略时按确定性顺序选择首项；显式未知键保持不可用。变化百分比为 100 ×（对比值 / 基准值 − 1）。

parameters.name: serviceComparator
parameters.description: Exact comparator key from serviceSources. Omitted selects the second deterministic source. Keys retain hardware, curve snapshot, recipe, image, topology and workload identity. Stitched telemetry producer/exporter hashes do not split a snapshot; rows without one retain their own run, date and hashes. Never substitute a hardware name.
parameters.x-description-zh: serviceSources 中的完整对比来源键。省略时按确定性顺序选择第二项。来源键保留硬件、曲线快照、测试配置指纹、镜像、拓扑和工作负载标识。同一快照内不同 telemetry producer/exporter 的 hash 不拆分来源；没有快照的行仍按原运行、日期和 hash 区分。不能用硬件名称代替。

parameters.name: serviceTarget
parameters.description: Positive finite service-axis target: tok/s/user for streaming speed, seconds for TTFT/E2E. Omitted returns the curve and null target comparison. Numerical linear interpolation is bounded by each exact source; no extrapolation or interpolation across missing metric endpoints. Concurrency is unsupported.
parameters.x-description-zh: 有限正数服务轴目标：streaming speed 单位为 tok/s/user，TTFT/E2E 单位为秒。省略时返回曲线，目标值对比为 null。仅在各完整来源的实测范围内做数值线性插值，不外推、不跨越缺失指标端点。并发轴不适用。

parameters.name: roleShare
parameters.description: Include validated disaggregated prefill/decode energy shares on one output-token denominator, plus rolePoints with each pool’s W/GPU and role-local energy. Uses same-window aggregate J/output ÷ J/input to convert prefill J/input; share denominator is reconstructed prefill + decode energy, not pool-local token counts. Missing/invalid data is omitted or null. JSON only.
parameters.x-description-zh: 返回通过验证的分离式 prefill/decode 能耗占比，统一使用 output token 分母；rolePoints 另含各池的 W/GPU 和按本池 token 计的能耗。用同窗口总 J/output ÷ J/input 将 prefill J/input 转换为 J/output；占比分母为重建的 prefill + decode 能耗，不使用各池独立的 token 数。缺失或无效的数据会被省略或返回 null，仅支持 JSON。

parameters.name: powerFit
parameters.description: Include one ordinary least-squares line per source: measured mean W/GPU = P0 + m × output tok/s per allocated GPU (disaggregated output spread over prefill and decode GPUs). P0 is the zero-output intercept, not measured idle power; m is marginal J/output token. Sources with fewer than 3 distinct output rates return observations with fit null. JSON only.
parameters.x-description-zh: 按数据源分别返回普通最小二乘拟合：实测平均 W/GPU = P0 + m × 每个已分配 GPU 的输出 tok/s（分离式部署的输出量均摊到 prefill 和 decode GPU）。P0 是零输出截距，不是实测空载功耗；m 是每个输出 token 的边际能耗（J）。不同输出速率少于 3 个的数据源返回观测点，fit 为 null。仅支持 JSON。

parameters.name: powerBreakdown
parameters.description: Include powerBreakdowns: per hardware line (hwKey + precision, as in the chart legend), each point’s All in Measured W/GPU split into measured GPU, measured Grace CPU (NVL72 with valid socket telemetry), and the modeled host CPU, memory, NICs, NVSwitch, storage, PCIe and misc parts, fans, PSU loss, scale-out network share and PUE facility overhead. Parts are the deployment share ÷ allocated GPUs and sum to totalWattsPerGpu. Points without validated GPU telemetry or a supported system model are omitted. JSON only.

parameters.name: powerBasis
parameters.description: provisioned (default, All in Provisioned), modeled (All in Measured) or compare. For GW-year estimates, modeled filters source points to valid system-power inputs before building the curve at the same target, without extrapolation or historical substitution. compare uses identical valid-curve throughput for paired budgets; when no valid curve reaches the target, it retains the original provisioned estimate. provisioned-only keeps the original performance curve. All in Measured adds modeled components and PUE to measured inputs; it is not measured wall power. NVL72 rows need validated GPU telemetry; each compute tray takes an equal share of a modeled liquid-cooled rack, with measured Grace-socket power when the row has complete validated socket telemetry (CPU-rail-only and module-sensor readings are not accepted) and modeled Grace power otherwise. Both interpolation knots must share a power basis. powerSource records topology (chassis or nvl72-tray), cpu (measured or modeled), PUE and the pinned power-model revision. powerLabel marks paired estimates and full-chassis extrapolation; skipped reasons preserve missing coverage.
parameters.x-description-zh: provisioned（默认，整体预配功耗）、modeled（整体实测功耗）或 compare。按 GW 年估算时，modeled 先筛选满足系统功耗要求的数据点，再在同一目标值上构建曲线，不外推，也不借用历史数据。compare 的两种功耗方案使用同一条有效曲线的吞吐量；没有有效曲线覆盖目标时，保留原曲线的预配估算。provisioned 单独使用时仍沿用原性能曲线。整体实测功耗在实测输入上叠加组件估算和 PUE，并非墙上电表读数。NVL72 需要通过验证的 GPU 遥测，每个计算 tray 平均分摊建模液冷机架的功耗；带有完整且通过验证的 Grace socket 遥测时使用实测 Grace 功耗（不接受仅有 CPU rail 或模块传感器的读数），否则使用 Grace 功耗估算值。插值的两个数据点须采用相同功耗口径。powerSource 记录拓扑（chassis 或 nvl72-tray）、cpu（measured 或 modeled）、PUE 和固定的功耗模型版本；powerLabel 标明配对估算和整机外推，skipped 保留覆盖缺失原因。

get.description: Read-only gpu telemetry and full-record statistics using the dashboard's source handlers and calculation helpers. Unknown and repeated query keys return 400. The response includes resolved params and preserves missing evidence. Renderer-only styling is not an API parameter. Telemetry comes from one source per run: its stored DB series once the run is ingested, otherwise its GitHub artifacts. Stored coverage describes the entire run: complete means the recorded artifact/file inventory is present, partial means recorded telemetry is missing, and unknown means no complete inventory was retained; missingArtifacts names entirely missing artifacts and may be empty when only a file is incomplete. GitHub coverage is null (unassessed). Responses use private, no-store; an upstream database failure remains HTTP 503 rather than an empty dataset. File/host series retain separate identities. Raw rows and charts respect selected GPU indices. Statistics cover every chip of the selected file/host series, including startup and warmup, and are computed from its samples on each read; a stored series whose samples do not match its recorded sample count returns none. Mean is sample-weighted, P50/P95/P99 interpolate linearly at p*(N-1), and standard deviation divides by N. These statistics are not serving-window power or J/token. Line time remains relative to the first sample across all chips; missing metric readings are omitted rather than zero-filled. Correlations require both readings. This endpoint projects the raw GPU-metrics explorer, not the inference Power Timeline. Timeline role/window evidence comes from its existing series=power read plus benchmark power_audit. Timeline i_ptaxis, i_ptlines, i_ptwindow, i_ptfocus, i_ptutility and i_ptconc share fields control client rendering only and are not accepted here; they do not change raw telemetry or full-record statistics.

get.summary: VideoGenX dashboard and published comparison evidence
get.description: view=overview shares resultProjection with the /vgx results UI, admits one canonical 20-clip C1 workload with ten valid samples per hardware, and returns measured metrics plus separately labelled participating/allocated cost. Deployment cells are keyed by hardware, runtime (serving engine plus the optimizations its run configuration declared), participating GPUs, TP × Ulysses split and concurrency, so cells of two engines, or of one engine with and without an optimization, never replace each other. metadata.optimizations lists the declared optimization keys; runs recorded before the field existed list none. Missing allocation remains null. point.videoSecondsPerHour carries validated decoded output seconds per measurement wall hour from valid measured requests, excluding warmup. Video-second throughput and both per-video-second cost bases use this output rate. Missing valid output durations or older History without this optional field leave these metrics null; requested durationSeconds remains workload/filter metadata and is never a fallback. Default points require publication approval. unofficialrun selects only the exact run into overlayCells (selected GPU count) and overlayDeploymentCells (all matching GPU counts), excluding it from official cells, deployments and workload mix. A stored run keeps its actual approval; a run absent from History is read live from its public h3-results artifact documents, unapproved and without media; its clips still carry PSNR and unscored reasons from a trusted h3-quality artifact of the same run attempt. Approved cohorts retain default preference; named-only workloads require explicit selection or no matching approved cohort. Clearing never promotes unapproved evidence. Dismissal retains a workload selector only if it remains in the approved choices. The overview returns JSON by default; format=csv returns selected official and named cells with source identities, units and both GPU cost bases as a private no-store download. duration_s is the requested plan duration; video_seconds_per_s beside clips_per_s is validated decoded output seconds per wall second. Missing values are empty CSV cells. Missing quality, stage timing, memory and startup evidence stays null. Play/pause, scrub, difference rendering, theme and expand controls are presentation-only; media uses the published-only read path. Read-only videogenx dashboard and published comparison evidence using the dashboard's source handlers and calculation helpers. Unknown and repeated query keys return 400. The response includes resolved params and preserves missing evidence. Renderer-only styling is not an API parameter. Default dashboard mode reuses published history → videoPoints → dashboardCells → metrics/plot/compare/evidence. Like the UI, it reads the first five history pages plus the latest source of every deployment older than them, reports coverage/truncation of the history pages, selects one canonical workload and keeps the shared sample floor. Cells stay separate per hardware, runtime, layout and concurrency; plot.frontiers holds one frontier per hardware and runtime, keyed <hardware>:<runtime>, where runtime is the engine (na when none was recorded) followed by any declared optimizations, joined by +. v_hidden affects chart/table only. view=compare additionally reads at most two already-published media artifacts, pairs cases with the UI helper and returns relative media paths without asset URLs; missing/failed media remains explicit. run/artifact or explicit discovery/results/tradeoff preserve the legacy contract. Discovery includes standard run-sweep runs; these may have no video artifacts. Run artifact listings cover all GitHub pages and retain legacy and unique native matrix names. Allocated GPU counts require retained scheduler allocation evidence; native power device counts cannot substitute for it. Missing allocation and allocation-normalized metrics remain null. No date range, full-catalog completeness, power/quality qualification or causal bottleneck claim is implied. Local bundles and arbitrary URLs are excluded. HTTP responses remain private, no-store. Published History and media metadata are cached across instances under the video tag, without a GitHub read. Errors, History pages whose index or approval reads failed and missing media are not retained; publication, History backfill or ?scope=video expires that cache at once. Server page seeding and first-frame preloading are presentation-only and change no selectors, metrics or source membership.

get.summary: uBenchX microbenchmarks with per-device protocols and bandwidth references (mem-bw, sm-l2-distance, tpc-skyline, and core-memory-profiles)
get.description: Read-only ubenchx microbenchmarks with per-device protocols and bandwidth references (mem-bw, sm-l2-distance, tpc-skyline, and core-memory-profiles) using the dashboard's source handlers and calculation helpers. Unknown and repeated query keys return 400. The response includes resolved params and preserves missing evidence. Renderer-only styling is not an API parameter. tpc-skyline also returns skuConfigurations separately from measured NVIDIA gpus. gpu=all (default) or Huawei 950PR includes all nine supplied 950PR configurations; an exact Ascend 950PR_<suffix> selects one. Rows preserve Cube/Vector/AICPU counts, MHz clocks, GiB memory, MiB L2, virtualisationOptions and raw ddrRate values with unit=null. Source metadata links the supplied screenshot and marks vendorSourceVerified=false; these are not topology measurements. test=all includes the same array inside tpcSkyline, honoring explicit gpu filters. core-memory-profiles defaults to gpu=all and returns Ascend 950PR_9579 first, followed by B200 SXM; gpu selects either device. B200 retains orderedSms, smInfo, gpcBounds, matrix, stats and metadata, with unit=clock64 cycles and its own colorLimits. The legacy sm-l2-distance API remains available with its original shape. Ascend returns panels with actual coreIds, dieGroups, full matrices, raw SYS_CNT tick units and unique-pair within/between-group statistics; a missing pair class is null. Shared colorLimits and limitations preserve the interpretation. These are profile differences, not core-to-core latency or a floorplan. mem-bw includes Huawei rotating-pool FP16 graph results. timeMs is amortized per copy for metadata.protocol=rotating-pool-npu-graph. peakBandwidthSource documents the per-run normalization reference; optional rows retain observations, bandwidthP10Gbps, bandwidthP90Gbps, processBandwidthGbps, slots and combinedPoolBytes. Missing sizes are listed in metadata.missingSizesBytes. get.description: Returns the versioned neutral dataset of the newest stored run. Each run is one uploaded CollectiveX results directory laid over the previous latest run (each uploaded case replaces the stored result of the same case) and holds at least one measured result: run_id is the upload time in epoch seconds (raised past the newest stored run when needed), run_attempt is 1, and run.source_sha is the collectivex/ commit the uploaded results were measured from. run.covered_skus lists only pools with a measured result. Runs are ingested when an operator uploads them, never on read. In series[].points[], components.*.latency_us, components.*.activation_data_rate_gbps_at_latency_percentile, components.*.payload_data_rate_gbps_at_latency_percentile and roundtrip_token_rate_at_latency_percentile carry p50, p90, p95 and p99; p90, p95 and p99 are null where the harness withheld a tail because too many samples were misaligned or host-stalled, while p50 is always a number. series[].library_version is the backend build the case ran (null where the result recorded none). Optional swap_blocks results contain verified copy latency in microseconds and payload GB/s (bytes counted once), with block_bytes, num_blocks, runtime provenance and skipped-point counts. Multi-pool sweeps preserve each GPU pool as an independent result. Each series carries maturity (candidate when no serving engine can select the configuration), and components.pair_period is the chained steady-state period, the headline latency.
get.x-summary-zh: 读取最新 CollectiveX 数据集
get.x-description-zh: 返回最新已存储运行的带版本中立数据集。每次运行对应一次上传的 CollectiveX 结果目录，叠加在上一次最新运行之上（上传的 case 会替换该 case 已存储的结果），且至少包含一个已测量结果：run_id 为上传时间的 Unix 秒级时间戳（必要时递增至最新已存储运行之后），run_attempt 为 1，run.source_sha 为测量这些上传结果所用的 collectivex/ 提交。run.covered_skus 只列出有已测量结果的资源池。运行在运维人员上传时导入，读取时不会导入。 在 series[].points[] 中，components.*.latency_us、components.*.activation_data_rate_gbps_at_latency_percentile、components.*.payload_data_rate_gbps_at_latency_percentile 与 roundtrip_token_rate_at_latency_percentile 包含 p50、p90、p95 和 p99；若测试工具因过多样本未对齐或被主机阻塞而未发布尾部延迟，p90、p95 和 p99 为 null，p50 始终为数值。series[].library_version 为该 case 运行的后端构建版本（结果未记录时为 null）。可选的 swap_blocks 结果包含校验通过的复制延迟（微秒）和有效载荷 GB/s（字节数仅计算一次），并保留 block_bytes、num_blocks、运行环境来源及未测量组合数。多池扫描分别保留各 GPU 池的独立结果。 每个序列带有 maturity（candidate 表示目前没有推理引擎可以选用该配置），components.pair_period 为连续成对的稳态周期，即主延迟指标。

softwareGain.description: Same-hardware gain on each date (aligned with dates): the series area divided by its area on its first snapshot, null before it appears. With groupBy=gpu the chip is fixed, so this is the improvement from software, serving configuration and precision.

The window is clipped to the first snapshot and needs at least half its length of history; null before that and where the series has no frontier. The Gain rate view plots one window at a time.

areas.description: Area under the frontier on each date (aligned with dates): the dominance step function integrated from zero to the fastest vertex. Lower-is-better metrics integrate the reciprocal so larger is always better. 0 before the first observation.

regressions.description: Series whose frontier on the latest date covers at least 10% less area than at its best so far. roster.x-description-zh: 默认包含 GB200、B200、MI355X 和 H200；存在符合门槛的已批准 H100、B300 或 A100 结果或明确指定的诊断运行时增加相应硬件。

totalParams.description: Billions of parameters; see model-specific features for excluded auxiliary modules.

activeParams.description: Billions of active parameters per token; decode count when activeParamsPrefill is present.

source_url.description: Relative raw benchmark request URL, including snapshot and power selectors. Resolve against the API origin.

returned.description: Rows from the raw request after any powerValid filter.

selected.description: Rows after raw-model, workload, hardware, framework and precision selection.

eligible.description: Selected observations with both finite numeric axes, including coordinate ties.

missing_or_nonfinite.description: Selected observations excluded for absent or non-finite axes.

num_prefill_gpu.description: Physical prefill chips; aggregate engines may mirror their single chip count in both role columns.

num_decode_gpu.description: Physical decode chips, independent of logical TP and DP. Sum role counts only for disaggregated engines.

metrics.description: Scalar metric map. Time metrics, including p99_itl and p99_tpot, are in seconds. p99_itl measures inter-token latency; p99_tpot measures per-request time per output token. Use the actual p99_itl field for an inter-token latency requirement, not the reciprocal of p99_intvty. Throughput metrics use tokens per second per GPU unless their name states otherwise; output_tput_per_gpu counts output tokens. On disaggregated rows tput_per_gpu divides by every chip, input_tput_per_gpu by prefill chips and output_tput_per_gpu by decode chips, for fixed-sequence and agentic runs alike. Agentic disaggregated rows also keep the original per-total-chip rates from the producer as input_tput_per_total_gpu and output_tput_per_total_gpu. Keys evolve independently; measured power / energy / GPU-telemetry keys are typed below.

power_valid.description: Publication verdict: 1 = validated measurement window; 0 = failed validation — measured power/energy values are withheld from this row end-to-end, so treat any that remain as unreliable; absent = no validation verdict is available in this response. Absence alone establishes neither the reason, the measurement age, nor invalidity.

power_metric_schema_version.description: Power schema version. Version 2 defines every unprefixed joules_per_* field as whole-deployment energy, including on disaggregated runs.

cpu_power_valid.description: CPU-side leg verdict (NVL72 Grace sockets or single-node AMD EPYC RAPL packages), independent of power_valid: 1 = the CPU-side (and module, when present) keys were integrated over the validated window with full socket coverage; 0 = the leg failed and no CPU-side keys are emitted; absent = the run had no CPU-side leg. Ingest withholds the CPU-side keys unless this verdict is 1, and power_valid = 0 does not remove them. GPU power and energy never change because of this verdict.

avg_power_w.description: Mean per-GPU power draw in watts during the measured load window.

avg_total_gpu_power_w.description: Mean total GPU power draw in watts across the measured deployment.

total_gpu_energy_j.description: Total GPU energy integrated over the measured deployment load window, in joules.

p75_power_w.description: Time-weighted P75 of synchronized total GPU-board watts, divided by participating GPU count, over the validated benchmark window with piecewise-linear interpolation. Not a percentile of individual-device percentiles; absent when not measured.

p75_total_gpu_power_w.description: Time-weighted P75 of synchronized total GPU-board watts over the validated benchmark window with piecewise-linear interpolation. Accelerator boards only, not chassis or facility power.

p90_power_w.description: Time-weighted P90 of synchronized total GPU-board watts, divided by participating GPU count, over the validated benchmark window with piecewise-linear interpolation. Not a percentile of individual-device percentiles; absent when not measured.

p90_total_gpu_power_w.description: Time-weighted P90 of synchronized total GPU-board watts over the validated benchmark window with piecewise-linear interpolation. Accelerator boards only, not chassis or facility power.

joules_per_successful_query.description: Whole-deployment energy in joules divided by successful requests.

joules_per_output_token.description: Energy per generated output token in joules; cluster-wide on schema-version-2 rows, including disaggregated runs.

joules_per_total_token.description: Total system energy divided by input plus output tokens; a workload-shape-fair view that does not treat prompt tokens as free.

prefill_avg_power_w.description: Mean per-GPU power draw in watts across prefill workers; emitted only for deployments with distinct prefill and decode roles.

decode_avg_power_w.description: Mean per-GPU power draw in watts across decode workers; emitted only for deployments with distinct prefill and decode roles.

joules_per_input_token.description: Energy per input token in joules; cluster-wide on schema-version-2 rows.

prefill_joules_per_input_token.description: Role-local prefill energy per input token in joules.

decode_joules_per_output_token.description: Role-local decode energy per generated output token in joules.

avg_temp_c.description: Mean per-GPU temperature in degrees Celsius during the load window.

peak_temp_c.description: Maximum instantaneous per-GPU temperature in degrees Celsius during the load window.

avg_util_pct.description: Mean per-GPU utilization percentage (0-100) during the load window.

avg_mem_used_mb.description: Mean per-GPU memory used in MB during the load window.

avg_cpu_socket_power_w.description: Mean over Grace sockets of each socket’s window-mean Grace-side power in watts (ACPI hwmon Grace Power Socket sensor, which NVIDIA defines only as the Grace socket power; modeled as the CPU and SysIO rails, LPDDR5X and socket regulation) over the same validated window as GPU energy. On single-node AMD rows (power_audit.cpu.sensor_kind = rapl_package) it is instead each EPYC package’s RAPL energy-counter power, which has no DRAM domain.

avg_total_cpu_power_w.description: Sum over every CPU socket in the deployment of window-mean socket power in watts (Grace side on NVL72, RAPL package on single-node AMD); dividing by avg_cpu_socket_power_w recovers the socket count (two per compute tray or AMD host).

total_cpu_energy_j.description: CPU-side energy in joules (Grace side on NVL72, RAPL package on single-node AMD) integrated over the validated window across every socket. Additive to total_gpu_energy_j, never included in it.

avg_total_module_power_w.description: Sum over sockets of window-mean compute-module power in watts (Grace + its Blackwell GPUs + HBM + LPDDR5X + regulator loss, ACPI hwmon Module Power Socket sensor); emitted only when the module sensor exists on every socket. It already contains the GPU-board watts, so do not add avg_total_gpu_power_w to it.

total_module_energy_j.description: Compute-module energy in joules over the validated window across every socket; emitted with avg_total_module_power_w and includes the GPU energy.

avg_total_cpu_rail_power_w.description: Sum over Grace sockets of window-mean CPU core rail power in watts (ACPI CPU Power Socket sensor, no SysIO); emitted only when every socket reports a gap-free rail. A breakdown inside avg_total_cpu_power_w, not additive to it. NVL72 only.

total_cpu_rail_energy_j.description: CPU core rail energy in joules over the validated window across every socket; emitted with avg_total_cpu_rail_power_w and already included in total_cpu_energy_j.

avg_total_cpu_sysio_power_w.description: Sum over Grace sockets of window-mean SysIO rail power in watts (ACPI SysIO Power Socket sensor); emitted only when every socket reports a gap-free rail. A breakdown inside avg_total_cpu_power_w, not additive to it. NVL72 only.

total_cpu_sysio_energy_j.description: SysIO rail energy in joules over the validated window across every socket; emitted with avg_total_cpu_sysio_power_w and already included in total_cpu_energy_j.

power_invalid_reasons.description: Producer snake_case reason codes explaining a withheld measurement, present when metrics.power_valid == 0. Absent on legacy rows and validated rows.

source.description: Collector that produced the CPU-side samples: acpi (hwmon), dcgm, or rapl (AMD EPYC package energy counter).

cpu.description: CPU-side leg provenance emitted alongside cpu_power_valid: the sensor kind that fed the CPU-side keys (on NVL72, module preferred over grace_socket over dcgm_cpu_rail; rapl_package on single-node AMD EPYC hosts), its collector, expected vs. observed sockets (two per compute tray or AMD host), stored sample rows, and the leg’s reason codes (empty when valid). Absent on runs without the CPU-side leg.

Present on valid and invalid rows when emitted; absence alone does not establish age or validity.
